terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} go opin naw de rɔn {method}.

sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Instɔl bay SP Flash Tul GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI go opin naw wit yu famwɔya we dɛn dɔn lod bifo tɛm.

• Insay SP Flash Tul, pik "Download" frɔm di drɔpdɔwn bɔks.
• Klik di "Download" bɔtin.
• Mek shɔ se yu {device} dɔn ɔf ɛn i nɔ kɔnɛkt am.
{hint} .
• Kɔnekt di USB kebul to yu kɔmpyuta afta yu dɔn klik Daunlod.

Klik OK fɔ lanch SP Flash Tul ɛn kɔmɔt na Updater CE.

support_story_1_headline: We di wan dɛn we de mek tin dɛn de go bifo, di kɔmyuniti kin step ɔp.
support_story_1_lead: Fɔ protɛkt yu divays frɔm saylent hadwae trap ɛn brok rivishɔn.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis kin rol ɔut nyu famwɔya ɔltɛm fɔ pleya dɛn lɛk di Y1 (we de target hiden bod rivishɔn dɛn lɛk 6.0, 7.0, ɛn 8.0) we de brok ol divays dɛn kwayɛt wan. Wos, dɛn wɛbsayt de gi ziro wɔnin ɛn ziro akses to fɔs wok famwɔya fɔ rikava frɔm wan brik stet. Updater CE ɛn di Community Firmware projɛkt pik di pis dɛm: wi de arkiv ɛvri lɛgsi stok ROM, ɔtomɛtik verify yu hadwae rivishɔn, ɛn kip yu pleya de rɔn sef wan.
support_story_1_item_1: Rescuing Broken Players: Sefty chɛk de mek shɔ se nyu ɔpdet dɛn nɔ de ɛva brik ol hadwae.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Kɔmplit kɔlɛkshɔn fɔ ɔrijinal faktri famwɔya dɛn Innioasis dɔn dilit.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Ful flashin tul fɔ macOS, Linux, ɛn Windows ɔl tu.
support_story_1_item_4: Hadwɔd Intɛlijɛns: Ɔtomatik bod ditekshɔn so yu kin gɛt di rayt pakej ɔltɛm.
support_story_2_headline: No brok Google Drives nɔ de. No guess-wok nɔ de. Jɔs de wok famwɔya.
support_story_2_lead: High-speed, verified komyuniti infrastrakcha we yu kin rili dipen pan.
support_story_2_body: Trak dɔŋ ɔfishal Innioasis softwe kin min fɔ skɔ fɔm fɔ Google Drive link dɛn we dɔn dɔn, day Baidu klawd sheri, ɛn mistɛri zip fayl dɛn we nɔ gɛt ɛni tul we de flash. Wi bil wan rilibul, indipɛndɛnt dawlod nɛtwɔk wit verify SHA-256 intɛgriti, ɔpdet notis, ɛn stɛp-by-stɛp gayd instɔl. Yu doneshɔn dɛn kin kip di dawlod ɛn ɔs we de mek dis pɔsibul 24 awa ɛvride, 365 dez insay di ia dairekt wan.
support_story_2_item_1: Dairekt Ay-Spid CDN: Fast, dairekt dawlod we nɔ gɛt ɛni dawlod limit ɔ day link.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Get alerted di moment we nyu kɔmyuniti rilis ɔ fiks dɛn drɔp.
support_story_2_item_3: Gayd Step-by-Step Installs: Klia visual prompts de waka yu tru ɛvri bɔtin we yu prɛs.
support_story_2_item_4: Kɔmyuniti we de tɔk bɔku langwej dɛn: Ful lokaliz insay Inglish, Chaynish, Jaman, Spanish, Frɛnch & Japan.
support_story_3_headline: Unlocking di ful potenshal fɔ yu Innioasis pleya.
support_story_3_lead: Bring Rɔkbɔks, kɔstɔm laytwɛt ɔpreshɔn sistem, ɛn ɔdiofayl fridɔm.
support_story_3_body: Stok faktri softwe de onli skrach di surface of wetin yu Y1 or Y2 hadwae kin du. Wi kɔmyuniti bin mek Rɔkbɔks, laytwɛt kɔstɔm ɔpreshɔn sistem, ɔdiofayl kɔdɛks ple bak, ɛn kɔstɔm tim dɛn kam layf. Wi de bay fizik hadwae vɛryushɔn aut-ɔf-poket fɔ tɛst, rivas injinia, ɛn chɛk ɛvri instɔl. Sɔpɔt Updater CE de fɔnd dɛn tɛst yunit ya dairekt wan ɛn aksɛleret kɔstɔm famwɔya divɛlɔpmɛnt.
support_story_3_item_1: Wan-Klik Rɔkbɔks: Odiofayl ple bak ɛn kɔstɔm tim dɛn we dɛn dɔn instɔl insay sɛkɔn.
support_story_3_item_2: Kɔmyuniti Famwɔya: Batri ɛnhansmɛnt, klin UI, ɛn mɔdan odio kɔdɛks sɔpɔt.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Wi de tɛst pan rial fizik divays dɛn bifo wi rilis ɛni bild.
support_story_3_item_4: Ziro Bloatware: 100% fri, prayvet-fɔs softwe we nɔ gɛt ɛni advays ɔ trak.
support_story_4_headline: Ɛp wi fɔ du wetin Innioasis nɔ de du.
support_story_4_lead: Kɔmyuniti-pawa famwɔya prɛzɛvɛshɔn we de mek yu divays dɛn nɔ de na say dɛn we dɛn kin trowe dɔti.
support_story_4_body: We wan hadwae kɔmni muf go to dɛn nɛks gadget, ol mɔdel dɛn kin lɛf. Innioasis nɔ de gi ɛni Linux sɔpɔt, nɔ transparent chenjlɔg, ɛn nɔ izi we fɔ rikavari we instɔleshɔn nɔ wok. Updater CE de bikɔs passionate yuza dɛn nɔ fɔ gɛt fɔ trowe wan pafɛkt gud myuzik pleya. 100% pan di kɔmyuniti kɔntribyushɔn de go dairekt fɔ kip dis tul opin fɔ ɔlman.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Prɔvab rikavari de flɔ ivin we divays dɛn nɔ gri fɔ but.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Fɔs-Klas Sɔpɔt: Ful sɔpɔt MediaTek we de flash pan Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Ditayl rilis not dɛn so dat yu go no gud gud wan wetin chenj.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Kɔmyuniti Fɔnd: Ɛvri kɔfi de kip di arkiv opin ɛn fri fɔ ɔlman.

err_sp_com_port: Di tul nɔ bin ebul fɔ opin in siriɔs pɔt. Klos ɔda tul dɛn we de flash ɛn kɔnɛkt bak.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Di USB COM pɔt nɔ bin ebul fɔ opin (ɛrɔ 1013). We yu stat yu kɔmpyuta bak, i go fri di pɔt we dɛn dɔn lɔk. Duya stat yu kɔmpyuta bak ɛn tray bak.
err_sp_enable_dram: Di tul nɔ bin ebul fɔ stat di pleya in mɛmori. Yuz di paket we dɛn bil fɔ dis ɛksaktɔl mɔdel.
err_sp_storage_read: Di tul nɔ bin ebul fɔ rid di say we di pleya bin de kip tin dɛn. Chek di kɔnɛkshɔn; di divays kin gɛt hadwɔd fɔlt.
err_attempt_timeout: Di tul we de flash nɔ sho ɛni prɔgrɛs insay {seconds} sɛkɔn, so dɛn stɔp dis tray.
err_connection_failed_desc: Nɔ bin ebul fɔ mek wan stebul kɔnekshɔn wit di pɔsin we de ple. Mek shɔ se di divays dɔn ɔf (yuz pin fɔ pres di riset bɔtin if nid de), pul di USB, ɛn kɔnɛkt bak we dɛn aks yu.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Dɛn bin ambɔg di flash ɔ di rayt ɔpreshɔn nɔ bin wok. Chek se di USB kebul dɔn plɔg fayn fayn wan ɛn di bateri gɛt inof chaj, dɔn tray bak.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: I tan lɛk se di flash dɔn stɔp
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Di tul we de flash dɔn sho di sem layn fɔ di las {seconds} sɛkɔn ɛn i nɔ tan lɛk se i de kɔntinyu fɔ rayt di famwɔya. Sɔntɛm di flash nɔ bin wok. If dis na bin di las wan pan tu tray wit ɛni we pan wan sistɛm we kin fɔdɔm bak bitwin dɛn, ɔ if na MTKClient nɔmɔ de na dis mashin, stat di kɔmpyuta bak ɛn tray bak.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Na MTKClient nɔmɔ de fɔ dis instɔl. Sɔntɛm di flash nɔ bin wok. Duya stat di kɔmpyuta bak ɛn tray bak.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Dis kɔmpyuta kin instɔl bak bay we yu de yuz SP Flash Tul. If yu ebul, chenj to SP Flash Tul ɛn tray bak.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Sɔntɛm di flash nɔ bin wok. Duya rid di mɛsej we de ɔp ɛn stat di kɔmpyuta bak bifo yu tray bak. If yu klik OK, di ap go kɔmɔt so dat yu go ebul fɔ stat bak.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Di famwɔya pakej nɔ gɛt di skata fayl ɔ di imej fayl dɛn we dɛn nid. Duya, dawnlod di paket bak ɔ pik wan kɔmplit famwɔya fayl.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Di ɔthɛntishɔn fayl we yu pik nɔ de, i ɛmti ɔ dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ rayt am. Pik wan fayl we rayt, ɔ klia am na Sɛtin dɛn, dɔn flash am bak.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Di flashin tul ɔ di sistem drayva dɛn we dɛn nid nɔ bin ebul fɔ initialize. Duya chɛk di sistem pɔmishɔn, di drayva sɛtup, ɔ ri-instɔlɔ di aplikeshɔn.
err_driver_missing_title: MediaTek USB Drayva nid fɔ de
err_driver_missing_desc: Dis mistek kin apin we di MediaTek USB drayva nɔ instɔl. Klik Download Drivers fɔ instɔl di MediaTek USB drayva, stat yu kɔmpyuta bak, ɛn tray bak.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Wan kesh famwɔya fayl nɔ de. Pik Pik Sɔftwia fɔ bil bak di fayl dɛn we yu dɔn pul ɔ dawnlod di famwɔya arkiv bak. Dis na lokal fayl prɔblɛm, nɔto USB kɔnɛkshɔn prɔblɛm.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Go bak to Selekt Sɔftwia fɔ bil bak ɔ dawnlod di famwɔya pakej.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Pik wan famwɔya rilis fɔ dawnlod bak.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Wan mistek we dɛn nɔ bin de ɛkspɛkt bin apin we dɛn bin de instɔl am ({detail}). Pawa ɔf di pleya kɔmplit wan, kɔnɛkt bak we dɛn aks am, ɛn tray bak.
flash_method_confirm: Instɔl we dɛn chenj to {method}. Kɔnfɛm se di pleya dɔn pul di plɔg ɛn i dɔn ɔf, dɔn klik Nɛks.
flash_failover_note: {method} nɔ bin mek di instɔl bigin. Afta di pleya dɔn ɔf ɛn pul di plɔg, dɛn go yuz {other} insted.
themepack_card_desc: Inklud fayn fayn kɔmyuniti tim dɛn, ay-rɛzolushɔn bakdrop dɛn, ɛn font dɛn we dɛn mek spɛshal fɔ 360p displei dɛn.
themepack_installed_success: 360p Theme Pack dɔn instɔl fayn fayn wan!
themepack_step1_title: Step 1: Kɔnekt insay USB Stɔrej Mɔd
themepack_step1_desc:
1. On yu pleya bay we yu ol di Pawa bɔtin.
2. We Rɔkbɔks de but, plɔg di USB kebul na yu kɔmpyuta.
3. If dɛn aks am na di pleya skrin, kɔnfɔm USB Storage mod so di divays go apia lɛk drayv.
themepack_step2_title: Step 2: Pik Ɛni Fɔlda na di Plɛya
themepack_step2_desc: Bikɔs ɔpreshɔn sistem dɛn (lɛk macOS) kin ayd dɔtfayl dɛn (lɛk .rockbox) bay difɔlt, yu kin pik ƐNI fɔlda ɔ di drayv rut na yu pleya. Wi go fɛn ɔ mek di .rockbox dairektrɔ fɔ yu ɔtomɛtik wan.
themepack_status_downloading: We yu de dawnlod 360p Tim Pak...
themepack_complete: Di tim pak dɔn instɔl fayn fayn wan! Naw yu kin diskɔnekt yu pleya sef wan ɛn pik wan tim na Rɔkbɔks (Sɛtin > Tim Sɛtin).
themepack_err_not_found: Nɔ ebul fɔ fɛn ɔ initialize wan .rockbox dairektrɔ na di drayv we yu dɔn pik. Duya mek shɔ se yu pik wan fɔlda na yu pleya.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Step 1: Ristart di pleya ɛn kɔnɛkt bak
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Diskonɛkt di USB kebul.
2. Pawa di pleya bak on ɛn lɛ i but insay Rɔkbɔks.
3. We Rɔkbɔks dɔn de rɔn, kɔnɛkt di USB kebul bak, dɔn prɛs Kɔntinyu.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Step 2: Luk fɔ di pleya ova ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Di ap de wach fɔ ADB kɔnɛkshɔn (te to 30 sɛkɔn). If dɛn fɛn divays, dɛn kin transfa di tim dɛn ɛn di pleya kin ribɔt ɔtomɛtik wan. If nɔto dat, skip bifo yu go na USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: We yu de wet fɔ wan ADB divays... (te to 30 sɛkɔn)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Divays we dɛn fɛn ({serial}); transfa tim dɛn...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: No ADB divays nɔ de we dɛn detekt insay 30 sɛkɔn; kɔntinyu wit USB Stɔrej Mɔd.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: No ADB binary nɔ de fɔ di ap; kɔntinyu wit USB Stɔrej Mɔd.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Push tim ɛn font dɛn oba ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB transfa nɔ bin wok; we de fɔdɔm bak to USB Stɔrej Mɔd
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Enable USB Storage Mode na di pleya so dat i go apia lɛk drayv.
2. Pik ƐNI fɔlda na di pleya we de dɔŋ (.rockbox, Music, Themes, ɔ di drayv rut, wan .rockbox fɔlda we ayd de de ɔtomɛtik).
3. Di ap de miks di 360p tim ɛn font dɛn insay, ɔvarayt di sem nem fayl dɛn.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Naw yu kin diskɔnekt di pleya sef wan ɛn pik wan tim na Rɔkbɔks (Sɛtin > Tim Sɛtin).
rockbox_cleanup_step: Fɔ pul di ol Rɔkbɔks sɛtin dɛn...
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: Fɔ pul di .rockbox fɔlda frɔm di pleya...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Dɛn bin dɔn instɔl yu nyu softwe, bɔt dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ pul di ol .rockbox fɔlda. Dilit di .rockbox fɔlda na di pleya wit yu an if yu want fɔ stat klin.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: I pas wan pleya we gɛt kɔnekshɔn. Diskonɛkt di ɔda wan dɛn ɛn lɛf di wan nɔmɔ we dɛn de instɔl.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Plɛya we dɛn dɔn detekt. Plɛs kɔmyuniti tim & font dɛn...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Fɔ put tim fayl dɛn ({curr} pan {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Hol di sɛnta bɔtin fɔ pawa pan yu Y1, kɔnɛkt USB bak, ɛn pik USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Hol di pawa bɔtin fɔ pawa pan yu pleya, kɔnɛkt USB bak, ɛn pik USB Storage Mode.

1. Pik ‘USB Storage Mode’ na yu pleya.
2. Klik ‘Browse Folder...’ fɔ pik yu pleya ɛn instɔl tim dɛn.

settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
